title: Umbrage Hill

location.name: Umbrage Hill
location.description: A lonely windmill atop a wind-scoured hill, home to the herbalist Adabra Gwynn. A manticore, driven down from Icespire by Cryovain, has decided the windmill would make a fine new lair — with Adabra as its first meal.

read_aloud: The wind never stops on Umbrage Hill. A lone stone windmill turns against the grey sky — and something is circling it. A winged, lion-bodied beast with a face like a cruel man's rakes the air, loosing volleys of iron spikes from its lashing tail. Below, a woman's voice cries out from the barred windmill door: 'Help! It won't leave — it's been at me all morning!'

enemies.special: Stays aloft, raining tail spikes (3/turn, range 100 ft). Only lands to bite a weakened target. Flees to Icespire if reduced below ~15 HP.

encounters.tactics: This is a flying skirmish on open ground — the manticore punishes parties with no ranged/reach answer. It kites at range, using the windmill and hill for line-of-sight breaks. Grounding it (net, Web, grapple on a landing, difficult flight conditions) is the key. Protect Adabra.
encounters.description: A single dangerous flyer versus a party on open terrain. Adabra Gwynn is the protect-the-NPC objective.

npcs.name: Adabra Gwynn
dialog_hooks: Herbalist and midwife; rewards the party with potions of healing she brews
If saved, becomes a friendly supplier of healing potions for the campaign
Knows the surrounding wilds and can point the way to other quest sites

loot.location: Falcon's bounty for clearing Umbrage Hill

skill_checks.success: Read the manticore's flight pattern to predict its dives (advantage to ready an attack against it).

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): a single manticore is under-tuned for 6 PCs; give it max HP (68) and, if the party has strong ranged output, a second manticore mate arriving round 3 (mention circling shapes). Reward grounding tactics. Protect Adabra (~9 HP behind the door). 3+ interactables: turning windmill sails (cover/knock a flyer), exposed hill wind (ranged disadvantage in gusts), windmill roof (a perch to reach the manticore).
